# The Montessori Notebook

> A comprehensive resource for Montessori parenting and education led by AMI-certified educator Simone Davies, offering online courses, books, and practical guidance for families implementing Montessori at home.

The Montessori Notebook provides practical Montessori education resources for parents and educators, featuring Simone Davies' published books (Baby, Toddler, Child), online courses, a popular podcast, and a blog with activities and parenting tips. The site serves as both an educational platform and a media presence for Davies' work in bringing Montessori philosophy into everyday family life.

## Core Offerings

- [Home - The Montessori Notebook](https://themontessorinotebook.com): Homepage featuring Simone Davies' Montessori online courses and resources
- [Montessori Online Courses](https://themontessorinotebook.com/online-courses): Practical Montessori online courses for home learning and parent training
- [Books by Simone Davies](https://themontessorinotebook.com/books-simone-davies): Simone Davies' Montessori books for families: Baby, Toddler, Child
- [The Montessori Notebook Podcast](https://themontessorinotebook.com/the-montessori-notebook-podcast): Podcast featuring Simone Davies' conversations on Montessori parenting

## Learning Resources
